title: Power one sequential tests exist for weakly compact $\mathscr P$ against $\mathscr P^c$
summary: We study power-one sequential testing for an i.i.d. law on a Polish sample space. Given a nonempty composite null class $\Pcal\subseteq\mathcal M_1(\X)$, we ask when there exists a level-$α$ stopping rule that rejects almost surely under every alternative in a prescribed class $\Qcal\subseteq\Pcal^c$.
